_description: Airtable field schema for ServiceFlow-Agent. Create a table named per TABLE_NAME in .env (default: client_records). All fields except channel_user_id are optional but strongly recommended.

fields.name: channel_user_id
fields.notes: Unique user ID from the channel (e.g. LINE userId). Primary lookup key — used in filterByFormula.

fields.name: case_type
fields.notes: Add your own service area names to match business_guide.json

fields.name: status
fields.notes: active/in_progress/paused → agent replies; human_takeover → agent silent; completed → terminal

fields.name: client_scenario
fields.notes: Auto-generated narrative for marketing/case-study use (anonymized by the agent)

fields.name: first_contact_at
fields.notes: UTC. Set once on record creation, never overwritten.

fields.name: last_interaction_at
fields.notes: UTC. Updated on every message from the user.
